body: Open-Source Agent Observability & Evals for AI Platform teams. Trace, test, route and govern every agent & coding assistant in the company.
plain_description: **Help your team trace, test, route, and govern AI use across the company.** Track agent and coding assistant activity, run evaluations, and manage gateway budgets. Self-host it or use LangWatch Cloud.
technical_description: LangWatch is an open-source platform for AI observability, agent testing and evaluations, prompt management, coding-agent tracking, AI gateway routing, and AI governance. It offers a cloud option and a self-hosted setup requiring Node.js 24 or newer. The README describes an OpenAI-compatible gateway endpoint and integrations with frameworks, coding assistants, and model providers.
title: LangWatch
